thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: P1 - elevated 5xx + p99 latency spike on /v1/generate since 2026-03-15T14:05:16Z after canary deploy 2026-03-15T14:03Z. p95 -> 3.2s, p99 -> 18.6s, 5xx rate 6.3%. Link: https://metrics.redwood.internal/alerts/1765439876
oncall-anya: ack. I'm on it. grabbing logs and tracing.
sre-jordan: oncall-anya ping me if you need help. looks like multiple gateways reporting connection reset from runtime pool.
eng-runtime-leah: seeing increased connection_reset and upstream 502s in the runtime pods, starting a live tail of pod logs.
eng-network-ryan: I can check load-balancer health and keepalives. tagging @eng-runtime-leah.
oncall-anya: scoping impact: support stream shows ~7% error rate across customers; some enterprise tenants see 10-12% failures. No broad data plane outage, skewed towards long-running requests.
support-leda: customer queue: a handful of 1st-line escalations incoming, flagging enterprise accounts A and B. Notifying CS.
eng-runtime-leah: logs (excerpt):
```
2026-03-15T14:05:20Z runtime-pod-12 ERROR upstream reset by peer during send chunk, conn_id=0x7ff
2026-03-15T14:05:21Z runtime-pod-12 WARN slow_kv_fetch ms=10234 model=redwood-giant
2026-03-15T14:05:22Z runtime-pod-12 ERROR batch_executor timed out waiting for worker, queue=25
```

sre-jordan: tracing shows increased tail latency on kv store calls and some stalls on model loading. Could be memory pressure + new kernel path from canary.
oncall-anya: deploy-bot, what changed in canary?
deploy-bot: Canary 2026-03-15T14:03:00 - runtime: kernel selection tweak (attn-optimizer-v2), batching heuristics adjusted (min_batch_ms=6). No config changes to LB.
eng-runtime-leah: attn-optimizer-v2 introduced a new memory allocation path; rolling it back on one canary replica now to test.
eng-network-ryan: LB shows many connections in CLOSE_WAIT from runtime pods starting at 14:04. suggest draining one AZ to isolate.
oncall-anya: Jordan & Leah, try quick rollback of the canary. If rollback not immediate, apply circuit-breaker: 503 fallback routing to previous model variant.
sre-jordan: starting rollback of canary at 14:09:03Z. command: `kubectl set image deploy/runtime-canary runtime=runtime:stable-20260314`
eng-runtime-leah: rollback acknowledged, scaling canary down and rolling stable up. Watching p99.
eng-runtime-leah: p99 down from 18.6s -> 2.1s within 90s of rollback. 5xx rate dropping to 0.7%
oncall-anya: great. Confirming rollback completed at 14:10:35Z.
support-leda: informing impacted customers: CS draft prepared, waiting for final wording and ETA for RCA.
product-ops-noah: need customer-facing summary and whether any data loss occurred.
sre-jordan: no data loss detected. requests failing returned 5xx; recommend compensating guidance: retry with jitter, exponential backoff.
oncall-anya: diagnostics notes captured. Creating incident record: https://incidents.redwood.internal/1765439876
product-ops-noah: ETA for postmortem? prefer <48h and a short workaround doc.
eng-runtime-leah: immediate action items: 1) revert attn-optimizer-v2 from canary (done), 2) enable additional circuit-breaker for long tail requests, 3) add KV call timeouts and stronger backpressure.
sre-jordan: Oncall Handoff: I'm handing this to night oncall at 23:00 UTC. Current state: stable after rollback but monitoring for regressions. Next oncall: oncall-lee.
oncall-anya: I'll create the follow-up runbook and add telemetry dashboards to track p95/p99 and 5xx by model and AZ.
support-leda: sending customer notifications now. Template: "We experienced elevated error rates and timeouts following a canary deploy, which we've rolled back. Some requests failed; we recommend retries. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with an RCA."
product-ops-noah: +1 on timeline and RCA. escalate if customers request credits.
eng-network-ryan: logging issue: please capture tcpdump if another spike occurs; I have a filter ready. command snippet: ```sudo tcpdump -i eth0 host 10.2.3.4 and tcp and '(tcp[tcpflags] & (tcp-rst) != 0)' -w /tmp/rst.pcap```
sre-jordan: creating jira INC-1765439876 for postmortem and action items. assigning to eng-runtime-leah and eng-network-ryan.
oncall-anya: final: status -> mitigated, rollback complete, customer notifications sent, next steps documented. If anyone sees a new spike, re-open this thread. :white_check_mark:
product-ops-noah: Thanks team. leaving as resolved here; handoff notes in the incident doc.
